title: What makes an early-stage investor look closer?
sourceTitle: Attracting Early-Stage Investors: Evidence from a Randomized Field Experiment
summary: A randomized angel-outreach study found that founding-team information influenced initial investor interest.
limit: Interest in learning more was measured; the study does not establish closed funding or prove that traction is irrelevant.
takeaway: Show relevant founder capability alongside the problem and evidence.

title: Digital signals and Indian startup financing
sourceTitle: Digital start-up access to venture capital financing: What signals quality?
summary: The study examines financing associations in a sample of 102 Indian startups that had already obtained funding.
limit: An already-funded sample cannot establish a causal benefit for previously unfunded idea-stage founders.
takeaway: Use online presence as context rather than a funding score.

title: Can online visibility widen investor access?
sourceTitle: Social Media Alleviates Venture Capital Funding Inequality for Women and Less Connected Entrepreneurs
summary: Research using Twitter and Crunchbase suggests that online communication may support discovery for less-connected founders.
limit: It concerns existing social platforms and selected venture populations. Its relevance to an Indian pre-product service remains unproven.
takeaway: Make progress accessible, then measure whether relevant investors actually respond.

title: Pre-seed and seed investors have different criteria
sourceTitle: What differentiates angel investors in pre-seed versus seed-stage investments? Evidence from India
summary: Observational research on 732 investments by 405 investors examines differences across pre-seed and seed stages.
limit: Completed-deal differences do not establish idea-only eligibility or demand for a new marketplace.
takeaway: Match actual stage appetite, evidence requirements, and check size separately.

title: Pre-product investing already exists
year: Official offering checked in project research
summary: Antler's India page welcomes pre-launch, pre-product, and pre-revenue teams through its selective investing and programme routes.
limit: An advertised offering does not establish an applicant's funding probability or the health of any other platform.
takeaway: Differentiate through useful discovery, investor fit, and ongoing relationships rather than claiming to invent funding before launch.
